Tables of the grid square statistics of the Population Census

Source: R/census-grid-get.R
census_grid_tables.Rd

census_grid_tables() lists the tables of census_grid_get(), and census_grid_items() their items, as given in the definitions of the tables on e-Stat. The tables of 2010 have only the population by sex and the number of households, and its 250 m table covers only 東京都特別区部, designated cities, and prefectural capitals.

Usage

census_grid_tables()

census_grid_items()

Value

census_grid_tables() returns a tibble with one row per table: stats_id (the identifier of the table on e-Stat), year, survey_date, grid_size, table_code, table_name, and collection_name, as published.

census_grid_items() returns a tibble with one row per item of each table: stats_id, item_code (the name of its column in census_grid_get()), level (the depth of the item in the table), item_name, and unit, as published.

Examples

census_grid_tables()
#> # A tibble: 18 × 7
#>    stats_id  year survey_date grid_size table_code table_name    collection_name
#>    <chr>    <int> <date>      <chr>     <chr>      <chr>         <chr>          
#>  1 T000608   2010 2010-10-01  1km       001-01     男女別人口総数及び世帯総… 平成２２年国勢調査－世界測地…
